title: Master's Academy Arts & Academics
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Serving the homeschool community since 1997, Master’s Academy Arts & Academics in Marietta, GA, offers programs in fine arts (music, art, and drama) on Mondays and academics on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We strive to create an environment for students to flourish through partnering, accepting, and inspiring: Partnering with homeschool families to provide education excellence in the fine arts and academics.
